public.text: Allowing foundational identity authorities to consume patient-matching APIs could increase surveillance or deterrence risks for undocumented persons or people using sensitive services.
public.suggestedRevision: Make such integration optional and use-case-specific. Require separation of health identity from legal-identity enforcement, strong access controls, audit, transparency, and protection against denial of care.
